cr-wabeno-bank-loot-1921.st: In June 1922 the sheriff brought robber Lesperance from Waupun to search the woods near Wabeno for the $8,000 he said was hidden in the underbrush; the Yaeger brothers were promised 10 years off if it was found. Nothing turned up.
src: Superior Evening Telegram 1922-06-06 p7 (newspapers.com image 1240717664); Merrill Daily Herald 1922-06-08 p8 (same wire)
